meetings.name: Contract signed
lines: pr
We signed the vendor contract with Tamsett Fare Systems today. Let me read out the clocks in the contract schedule so they are on record.
pr
Tamsett delivers the station validators 16 weeks from today.
pr
The pilot runs for 90 days from go-live.
pr
The final payment is due 45 days after the pilot ends.
pr
Tamsett must deposit the source code in escrow within 60 days of go-live.
pr
Any defect found in acceptance testing must be fixed within 30 days of being reported.
pr
The warranty runs for 12 months from acceptance.
pm
Thanks Tom. Apart from the validators, none of those clocks have started yet.

meetings.name: Go-live review
lines: pm
We went live this morning on the Northline stations. Well done, everyone.
it
Monitoring looks clean so far. Acceptance testing starts next month.

meetings.name: Acceptance testing
lines: it
I reported the turnstile double-charge defect to Tamsett this morning.
pr
Noted. I will chase their account manager.

meetings.name: Acceptance
lines: pr
We signed the acceptance certificate today.
pm
Good. The turnstile defect is still open.
